title: BiasGuard: A Reasoning-Enhanced Bias Detection Tool for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Classifying generated text as biased or unbiased using BiasGuard, an LLM-based detection tool enhanced with explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning and sociological fairness specifications, evaluated across multiple benchmark datasets (e.g., Toxigen, SBIC, RedditBias).
